Based on the report and reproduction, the problem is that any inline `style={{ height: '…' }}` passed to `<Search>` is being forwarded directly onto the `<input>` element, so you can shrink the field to 16 px (or anything else). We want to preserve the Carbon‐defined input height (40 px/48 px) and allow user styling only on the outer container.

Root cause
– In `Search.js`, all extra props (including `style`) are spread onto the `<input>`  
– An inline `height` on the input overrides the built-in CSS height rules

Fix
1. Pull `style` out of `...other` when destructuring props  
2. Apply that `style` to the root `<div>` instead of the `<input>`
